title: Uri Geller abducted as a child

tellings.quote: Yuri Geller has a similar story of being abducted, I think, as a as a young child and then he gained his psychic powers that way.

plain: Uri Geller, an Israeli man famous for claiming psychic powers, is said to have been abducted as a young child, and to have gained those powers through the experience. Michels brings this up himself, without naming a source and with a hedging "I think", in a conversation about UFOs, psychics and the afterlife. He offers it as a parallel to other stories of people who come back from such encounters changed.
